profile.headline: Senior Front-End Web Developer, netTALK.com
profile.summary:
Innovative, detail-oriented, and experienced; proficient in design, development, and promotion of online services. A leader with strong communication, conflict resolution, and problem solving skills. Proven ability to train, manage, and mentor colleagues.

Areas of Expertise:
• Responsive Web Design
• User Interface (UI) & User Experience (UX) Design
• Web Application Programming
• Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
• Content Management Systems (CMS)
• Project Planning & Management
• Social Media and Email Marketing
• Data Modeling and Database Design

positions.title: Senior Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for leading and managing all facets of front-end web development and content creation for the company’s marketing websites and customer portals.

Key Contributions:
• Solely responsible in establishing the company’s initial online presence at product launch.
• Instrumental in the creation of the company’s white label system that supports multiple telecom company brands.
• Train and provide technical guidance to junior personnel.
• Technical copy writer and editor for product’s instructional and installation manuals and websites.
• Updating the User Experience of the online customer account manager
positions.insights: Skills: Attention to Detail · Figma (Software) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Motion Design · Graphic Design Principles · JavaScript · Visual Design · HTML · Email Campaigning

positions.title: Part-Time Adjunct Instructor
positions.description:
Contributed to the success of Miami Dade College’s Community Education program by combining technical expertise with acquired educational techniques to create engaging lesson plans. Courses include: Photoshop, Dreamweaver, and Principles of Web Design for both adults and teenagers.

Key Contributions:
• Developed student online portal containing technical training lessons. It included photos, graphics, and diagrams for various classes for students to access and download.
• Taught at three different campuses and maintained a high rating by students.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining the college’s websites and student intranet. Introduced new web-based solutions and technology to better showcase all the degree programs offered and increase student enrollment.

Key Contributions:
• Worked with college executives, academic deans, faculty, and staff; to initiate, plan, design, and code visually-engaging, database-driven micro-sites for each degree program offered at the college.
• Developed a custom-made content management system for updating the micro-sites.
• Designed and programmed a database-driven website to allow students and parents to search through the college’s Articulation Agreements and calculate tuition savings for high school classes taken by the student.
• Integrated PayPal with an online registration form for the College Connection summer camp for teens.
• Designed and coded marketing HTML emails to advertise degree programs and special events.
positions.insights: Skills: Attention to Detail · Graphic Design Principles · Visual Design

company.name: The Art Institute of Fort Lauderdale

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of graphic designers and web developers to create engaging, animated websites to promote new pre-construction properties for multiple real estate companies and developers.

Key Contributions:
• Designed and programmed reusable animated Flash modules that were used on multiple websites.
• Created flash-based navigations, website intros, and web banner ads.
positions.insights: Skills: Attention to Detail · Motion Design · Graphic Design Principles · Visual Design

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Created and updated content for the Medical Center Campus website and acted as photographer for events when needed.

Key Contributions:
• Converted printed forms to interactive HTML forms to improve efficiency and accuracy of information gathering.
• Redesigned content layout for multiple degree program web pages to improve usability and readability.

company.name: Miami Dade College: Medical Center Campus

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Designed, programmed, and maintained websites for the company’s clients.

Key Contributions:
• Utilized Miva Merchant to design and build e-commerce websites for clients.
• Educated clients on web terminology and project phases.
positions.insights: Skills: Attention to Detail · Visual Design
